input.text:
Six songs are within days of a big Spotify milestone, and The Weeknd's "Starboy" (3.996B streams, 1.9M a day) and Billie Eilish's "BIRDS OF A FEATHER" (3.986B) are both at the door of 4 billion. 🏆

The countdown from kworb's Spotify global daily chart, pulled Oct 15, 2026 (est. dates assume the daily pace holds): Starboy (The Weeknd & Daft Punk) 4B ~Oct 17; Olivia Rodrigo's "the cure" 500M ~Oct 18; "BIRDS OF A FEATHER" 4B ~Oct 22; Gorillaz's "Feel Good Inc." 1B ~Oct 27; Olivia Dean's "Man I Need" 1.5B ~Oct 29; The Chainsmokers & Halsey's "Closer" 2.5B ~Nov 2.

Together the six have 13.4B streams and add about 12.5M a day. "the cure" is the fastest mover at 3.53M a day, then "Man I Need" (2.52M) and "BIRDS OF A FEATHER" (2.13M).

Which song will be the next to hit 5 billion? 👇

Data: kworb.net Spotify global daily chart, Oct 15, 2026; milestone dates are estimates

#spotify #starboy #billieeilish #oliviarodrigo #musicstats
